sql:
SELECT pl.sku, p.category, SUM(pl.amount_cad) AS cad_amount
FROM lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.purchase_line pl
LEFT JOIN lightning.metastore.finmozg.finance_usl.product p ON pl.sku = p.sku
WHERE pl.currency='USD' AND pl.period='2026-09'
GROUP BY pl.sku, p.category
ORDER BY cad_amount DESC
LIMIT 20
